questionText:
You are in Huelva and you go to a shop to return an item you have bought. Complete in SPANISH your side of the following DIALOGUE.
Pilar: ¿En qué puedo ayudarte?
Tú: Explain that you bought a present for your mother here yesterday, a grey jacket. However, when you returned to your apartment you realized that it was too big.
Pilar: Bueno. ¿Quieres devolverla?
Tú: Yes, here it is. Tell her that you would like the same jacket but in size forty. Tell her this is your mother’s favourite shop in Spain.
Pilar: ¿Estás aquí de vacaciones?
Tú: Tell her you are here with a group of friends. You have just finished your exams and are spending a week here. You visited the city last year with your family.
Pilar: ¿Y qué es lo que más te gusta de Huelva?
Tú: Explain that you love the weather, of course, as it is much better than in Ireland. The people are also very friendly, like the Irish.
Pilar: Entonces, ¿te gustaría vivir aquí?
Tú: Your parents want you to go to university in Ireland. You would prefer to spend a year in Huelva first to improve your Spanish because you want to study languages in the future.

0 marks: No communication of message.

questionText:
You are planning to go to Spain after the exams. Your Spanish friend Enrique lives in Malaga. Write a letter / e-mail to him in Spanish. Use all of the points mentioned below:
- Tell him you don’t have much free time because you have to study for your exams.
- Say you are going to spend four weeks in Spain on holidays this summer.
- Explain that you will arrive in Malaga at the end of June.
- Mention two things you want to do when you are in Spain.
- Say you would like to speak a lot of Spanish with his friends.

taskRequirements: There are five points to be communicated.
Allow a maximum of 8 marks for each of these.
(0 – 8 marks may be awarded for each point.)
(5 x 8m = 40 marks)
Full message unequivocally conveyed: 8 marks
Communication satisfactory: 6 marks
Communication adequate: 5 marks
Message comprehensible / some details missing: 4 marks
Possible to extract some sense: 2 marks
rubric.markingGuideNote:
All answers must be in Spanish.
Candidates must attempt:
1. LETTER / E-MAIL and either 2. (a) NOTE or 2 (b) DIARY ENTRY.
practiceNotes: Write your answer in Spanish, then place it on the published grid. You are marked on this task alone, and where it asks you to choose statements, turns or points, on the ones you chose.
Mark each point you wrote on its own against the scheme's ladder above.

questionText:
You are talking to your Spanish friend Jorge about his plans to study abroad next year. Complete in Spanish the following dialogue. You should attempt any five of the following points:
Jorge: He conseguido una beca Erasmus para pasar un curso académico en una universidad extranjera el año que viene. ¡Qué ilusión!
Tú: Tell him that’s great news, you are delighted because the process to go on Erasmus is very long and difficult, especially the personal essay and the interview.
Jorge: Pues sí, estoy muy contento, y ¡mi familia está muy orgullosa!
Tú: Say that your sister did Erasmus in Austria three years ago, she enjoyed the experience and made friends from different countries. Ask him where he’s planning to study.
Jorge: Pues, no sé. La beca me permite elegir cualquier país de la Comunidad Europea.
Tú: You would love to go to Spain because it has such a rich culture. You’ve heard that Salamanca is one of the oldest universities in the world.
Jorge: ¡No lo sabía! En este momento estoy pensando en Francia o Irlanda.
Tú: Say that without doubt France has many advantages. The language is similar to Spanish, the universities offer a variety of courses and it is also close to Spain.
Jorge: Exactamente. Por ejemplo, si estuviera en Burdeos podría volver a Bilbao en tren algunos fines de semana.
Tú: Say that Ireland is a good option too. Outside Dublin it is not as expensive as France, but it can be difficult to find somewhere to live.
Jorge: Gracias por los consejos, no tengo que tomar una decisión hasta el mes que viene.
Tú: Ask him if he would like to go out at the weekend to celebrate. Say there is a concert in the stadium on Saturday and many of your friends are going to be there.

questionText:
You are interested in doing volunteer work for the summer. You go to an organisation in Madrid. Complete in Spanish the dialogue. You should attempt any five of the following points:
Begoña: Buenos días, ¿qué tal el viaje?
Tú: Say that it was complicated because your apartment is on the other side of the city. You are not used to a lot of traffic as you are from a small town in Ireland.
Begoña: Sí, los atascos son terribles. Así que ¿quieres hacer un voluntariado con nuestra ONG?
Tú: Say that you are interested in working in Latin America. Your brother took part in a project in Argentina last summer and said it was an unforgettable experience.
Begoña: Tenemos proyectos en Argentina, México y Perú. ¿Cuál sería tu opción preferida?
Tú: You would prefer to work in Argentina. Some of your friends are from there and you would love to meet up with them at the end of the summer.
Begoña: Argentina es preciosa. ¿Has traído una copia de tu currículum?
Tú: Tell her that you are sorry, you don’t have it with you. You sent a copy by email to her colleague Rosa a week ago, but she did not answer.
Begoña: Ahora lo veo. Háblame de tu experiencia laboral.
Tú: Say that your uncle works in construction and you worked with him last summer. Say that you are hardworking and you get on well with everybody.
Begoña: Estupendo, creo que podrías ser valioso/a para nuestro equipo en Argentina.
Tú: Thank her for her time. Say that you will ring your friend Pablo in Buenos Aires to tell him the good news when you return home.
